purpose: Measure whether the 100,000-row per-scenario development cap is truncating temporal support required for 8-minute clean-history / 4-minute future forecasting before changing the model again.
source: Official CTU IoT-23 timestamped Zeek conn.log.labeled scenarios
final_validation: locked; V31 is support-only and does not score final-validation families or model performance

temporal_protocol.eligible_rule: same one-hour-block boundary rule used by V23-V30
temporal_protocol.clean_history: no malicious-labelled bins in the 16-window history
temporal_protocol.clean_onset_event: development-family onset with the immediately preceding 16 bins attack-free
temporal_protocol.evaluable_event: clean-onset event with at least one eligible clean-history cutoff 30-240 seconds before onset

decision_rule: Recommend expanding the next development model beyond 100k rows only if 300k materially expands temporal support: longer usable scenario spans, clean-history future-positive sequences, or evaluable/candidate clean-onset support.
claim_boundary: V31 is a data-coverage audit only. It cannot establish forecasting accuracy, zero-day prediction, recall, FPR, or lead-time performance.
